sources: User-exported policy_test_results (2).json: six reviewed answers only
Independent browser session: eight additional questions, 24 answers
protocol.exclusions: Two earlier duplicate answers and one failed pre-index RAG attempt are preserved in the original pilot export, excluded from the 30-answer comparison.

review_rubric.correct: Supported, relevant and complete response, including acknowledging unavailable information.
review_rubric.partly correct: Useful supported information but irrelevant extra policies or incomplete handling of the question.
review_rubric.incorrect: Does not answer the question or recognise missing information.
review_rubric.unsupported: A factual assertion not supported by the full policy database; irrelevant verbatim text is a relevance error, not automatically an unsupported claim.

limitations: Selected sample; one run per question/method; no population-wide reliability claim.
Timing uses fixed method order across two browser sessions, not a randomized benchmark.
Per-question timing excludes initial index setup; query and setup embedding tokens were not reported.
Earlier reviews were assisted; the new qualitative review is attributed to Codex.
